title: Functions
goal: Functions declare, define aur call karna; parameters, return values, scope aur modular design samajhna.
definition: Function code ka named reusable block hai jo inputs (parameters) leta hai, kaam karta hai aur optional value return karta hai.
explain: Declaration (prototype) compiler ko signature batata hai; definition body deti hai; call function ko chalati hai. Prototype na ho to implicit declaration warning/error aata hai.
C me arguments by value pass hote hain — function ko copy milti hai. Original badalna ho to pointer bhejo (Module 13).
return ek value deta hai aur function turant khatam karta hai. void function kuch return nahi karta.
static local variable function calls ke beech value yaad rakhta hai; global variables avoid karo kyunki hidden coupling banate hain.
analogy: Function ek machine hai: raw material (arguments) daalo, machine process karti hai, finished product (return value) milta hai. Machine ko baar-baar use kar sakte ho bina dobara banane ke.
why: Bade program ko chhote testable units me todna hi professional code hai. Functions ke bina code duplicate hota hai aur bug fix har jagah karna padta hai.

syntax.note: Prototype semicolon par khatam; definition me body.

syntax.code:
void greet(const char *name) { printf("Hi %s\n", name); }
int counter(void) { static int n = 0; return ++n; }
syntax.note: void = koi return nahi; static local value retain karta hai.

topics.title: Declaration, definition, call
topics.body: Prototype compiler ko return type aur parameter types batata hai. Definition ek hi honi chahiye (ODR). Call se control function me jaata hai aur return par wapas.

topics.title: Parameters aur return
topics.body: Parameters callee ke local variables hain; arguments caller ki values. Return type aur actual return value match kare. Multiple values chahiye to struct return karo ya pointers se out-params.

topics.title: Call by value
topics.body: C default by value hai: swap(a,b) original nahi badalta. Pointer version swap(&a,&b) badalta hai. Arrays decay hoke pointer ban jaate hain, isliye function array ko modify kar sakta hai.

topics.title: Scope aur static
topics.body: Local variables block scope; static local lifetime poore program ki; global file scope (extern se share). static function file-private hota hai. Naam collisions se bacho.

topics.title: Modular organization
topics.body: Related functions ek .c file me, declarations .h header me, header guards ke saath. main.c sirf orchestration kare. Function pointers se behaviour pass kar sakte ho (callback).

mistakes.why: By value copy badalti hai, original nahi.

mistakes.wrong: int f(); int main(){ f(); } int f(){ return 1; }
mistakes.why: Call site par signature unknown hone se implicit declaration warning aata hai.
Comma operator sirf last value deta hai — intent clear nahi.

debug.brief: swap original values nahi badal raha. Fix karo.
hints: C by value pass karta hai.
Pointers lo aur & se call karo.
debug.fix: void swap(int *a, int *b) { int t = *a; *a = *b; *b = t; }  swap(&x, &y);

best: Parameters const karo jab modify na ho
Chhote functions likho jo test ho sakein

interview.q: Function overloading C me kyun nahi hai?
interview.a: C me name mangling nahi hoti; linker ke liye function ka naam hi identity hai. Same naam ke do functions duplicate symbol dete hain. C++ me mangling se overloading possible hai.
interview.followUp: C me alternative? — alag naam ya _Generic macro.

interview.q: Array function me pass karne par size kyun nahi aata?
interview.a: Array parameter pointer me decay hota hai, isliye sizeof pointer ka size deta hai. Size alag parameter me bhejo.
interview.followUp: 2D array? — columns ki width parameter me chahiye.

interview.a: Runtime par behaviour choose karna (callbacks, qsort comparator, menu dispatch). Syntax: int (*fp)(int,int) = add; fp(2,3).
interview.followUp: qsort comparator signature? — int (*)(const void*, const void*).
